label_reason: the validation registered in reports/entry_state_validation_registration_v4_2026-10-06.md has not run (it needs the survivorship-free constituent data); until it reports the state is a rule output, not evidence
prices: split-adjusted daily OHLC and volume as charted (yfinance auto_adjust=False)

trend.rule: fails (AVOID) only when the close is below the 200-day average AND the 12-month return excluding the last month is negative. A close below the 200-day average with positive momentum passes and sets the flag below_200d

setup.rule: information only, not required: the distance of the close from the 20-day average in ATR(14) units, RSI(14), and the close's position in the 40-session high-low range (0 = the low, 1 = the high). There is no WAIT state: an extended name and a pulling-back name read the same

entry.rule: a name that passes the trend gate is READY, whether it is extended or pulling back. The confirmation (a close above the prior session's high, or a close back above the prior 40-session low after closing below it) and its volume check (volume above 1.5 times the 50-day average) are shown as information and are not required

modifiers.rule: applied in order and shown on the card: below_200d halves the size; an earnings release within 20 sessions halves it (state READY-HALF); days-to-cover of 7 or more, or short interest of 20% or more of the float, halves it and sets the flag heavily_shorted (both measures, since a heavily traded stock can show a low days-to-cover while a large share of its float is sold short). The size never goes below one quarter of the base size: if the modifiers would go further, the state is WATCH

ceiling.rule: yearly closing highs over the lookback; a ceiling exists when at least two lie within 5% of each other, at least six months apart, each followed by a decline of at least 10% within three months (63 sessions; for the current year's high, the decline so far). The ceiling is the higher of the two. The flag is set when the close is within 15% below the ceiling and caps the state at WATCH until a close above it
ceiling.lookback_note: the order says 'the last 10 years'; its own reference (Incyte's September 2015 high) lies eleven years back, so the lookback covers the current calendar year and the eleven before it

stop.rule: the 40-session low (today included) minus 1 ATR(14). No floor at the 200-day average: the trend gate does not require the price above that average

size.rule: shares = risk budget (0.5% of account value) / (entry - stop) x the modifiers, then reduced until the name's post-entry share of book risk is below 40%. Entry = the close

methods.atr: simple mean of the true range over 14 sessions
methods.days_to_cover: the provider's short ratio (short interest / average daily volume) from the canonical fundamentals fetch
methods.short_pct_float: the provider's short interest as a share of the float (shortPercentOfFloat) from the canonical fundamentals fetch, same settlement date as the days-to-cover
methods.reference_check: reproduces the order's 5-Oct states for LMT, MU, POWL, INCY, TPL and ONDS (tests/test_entry_state.py)
